label: Rule metadata extraction
description: What is read from a rule's own text into its References and Other metadata (kept in sync on every change of the rule; existing rules: Admin → Bulk parse fields → References & metadata). reference_keys = keys whose values are references (YARA meta, Sigma / YAML keys, Elastic, KQL header comments…). skip_keys = keys never shown as other metadata: Rulezet already has them as fields, or they are the rule's logic. Limits keep one rule's JSON small.
